note: Read 2026-11-03, whole, from the Government of South Georgia & the South Sandwich Islands' own law site (laws.gov.gs; each file fetched again the same day and found the same): the Income Tax Ordinance 2016 (No. 3 of 2016; its 12-page scan read by OCR), the Income Tax Regulations 2016 (S.R.&O. No. 3 of 2016; its 2-page scan read by OCR) and the Government's Guide to the Ordinance. The Territory's income tax, administered by the Falkland Islands Government's tax office, is the only system there that could number a person, and it issues none and asks for none: an employer's advance notification gives the employee's name, address and email address and expected dates of arrival and departure (s. 10(2)), the quarterly return the income expected and the amount deducted (s. 11(4)), and the Regulations prescribe no further information (they set exemptions and the late-payment interest rate only). Read as: no national number is given. This rests on the whole text read, not on a sentence saying so (the lead's ruling of 2026-11-03).

sources.title: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, Income Tax Ordinance 2016 (Ordinance No. 3 of 2016)
sources.said: 10. Advance notification (1) A person (“the employer”) who proposes to employ an individual (“the employee”) to carry out work in the Territory in respect of which income tax may be payable must notify a tax officer. (2) Notification under subsection (1) must specify — (a) the employee’s name, address and email address; (b) the expected date of the employee’s arrival in the Territory; (c) the expected date of the employee’s departure from the Territory; (d) whether the employer expects the employee to return to the Territory in the same tax year; and (e) any other prescribed information. (OCR of the scan; no provision issues or names a taxpayer or identification number.)

sources.title: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, Income Tax Regulations 2016 (S.R.&O. No. 3 of 2016)
sources.said: 4. Exemptions (1) The following classes of individual are exempt from income tax under the Ordinance — ... 5. Interest rate The prescribed rate of interest for the purposes of sections 11(7) and 12(4) of the Ordinance (late payment) is 3% above the base rate set at the Standard Chartered Bank in Stanley from time to time. (OCR of the scan; nothing else is prescribed.)

sources.title: Government of South Georgia & the South Sandwich Islands, Guide to the Income Tax Ordinance (2016)
sources.said: When a person (the employer) intends to employ someone (the employee) to work in the Territory the employer must contact the Tax Office and tell them: the name of the employee; the date they expect that person to arrive in the Territory; the date they expect that person to leave the Territory; whether that person will be returning to the Territory in the same tax year.; whether that person is expected to be in the Territory for more or less than 183 days.
